payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all 6 possible dice outcomes, compare absolute differences to determine winner, and accumulate counts for first, draw, second.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively enumerates the 6 possible dice values, which is a complete search. Among the given subtypes, permutation enumeration is the closest, as it involves iterating over all possibilities, even though it is not technically generating permutations of a set.
